propositions: The five-phase rebar-janitor pipeline lacks validation of remediations proposed in Phase 3, allowing invalid proposals to reach Phase 4 approval unflagged

Two blind proposers in Phase 3 measure prompt stability rather than correctness because they read identical evidence; the gap closes by making them asymmetric (one queries OSS projects, one queries project records)

Phase 2 verification must add harm_reachable as a fifth validity sub-question requiring concrete triggering inputs, and prior_decision to surface deliberate recorded choices that a proposal might reverse
A finding that fails harm_reachable is reclassified from DEFECT to HARDENING (label only, subject to existing floors) and travels through Phase 3 to Phase 4 via the existing finding_refs union

Phase 3 replaces the OSS-research tiebreak with a divergence research round that buckets answers by weight (explicit rejection/adoption, adoption/exclusion, never considered) and maps them to agent-converged, research-resolved, or no-consensus outcomes

Phase 2 applies a -0.10 validity penalty only when explicit_justified prior_decision exists and the remediation direction does not name changed evidence; Phase 3 requires evidence_changed on plan items that reverse recorded decisions
